citation.title: Source
citation.note_workspace: Highlighted: the cited chunk inside the text extracted from the file ({length} characters).

grounding.title: Source check
grounding.only_unchecked: Not compared: the answer and its excerpts are in different languages
grounding.unchecked: {n} statement(s) were not compared because the answer and the excerpt are in different languages.
grounding.too_long: This answer is too long for the source check
grounding.disclaimer: The check compares the numbers, dates, times, codes, quotations and wording of each statement with the excerpts it cites. A match does not prove a statement correct; a flag means: open the source and check.
grounding.reason_fact_elsewhere: {fact} is in {other}, not in the cited {label}.
grounding.reason_uncited_found: No citation; the matching passage is {other}.
grounding.reason_uncited_missing: No citation, and {fact} is in none of the excerpts.
grounding.reason_low_overlap: Few of its words appear in {label}.
grounding.reason_unknown_citation: {found} is not one of the excerpts this answer was given.
grounding.reason_from_conversation: {fact} comes from the question or the conversation, not from an excerpt.
grounding.reason_not_delivered: {label} did not fit into the model's context.

receipt.title: Answer receipt
receipt.intro: A receipt lists the excerpts this answer cited, with a SHA-256 fingerprint of each file and the exact position of each passage. Anyone who has the same files can check that every excerpt is an exact, unchanged passage.
receipt.proves: Each workspace excerpt is an exact, unchanged passage of the file with the recorded fingerprint, at the recorded position. The source check can be recomputed from it.
receipt.not_proves: That Starpi wrote the answer (receipts are not signed), which excerpts the model actually read, that the answer is correct, or anything about knowledge-base excerpts.
receipt.privacy: The file is created on this device and contains excerpts of your documents and fingerprints that identify them. It only leaves this device if you share it.
receipt.verify_intro: Choose a receipt and the original files. Both are read on this device; files are matched by their fingerprint, not by their name.
receipt.verify_running: Checking the receipt against the files…
receipt.verify_invalid: This is not a valid Starpi receipt ({reason}).
receipt.summary: {ok}/{total} workspace excerpts reproduced from your files
receipt.id_ok: The receipt hash matches its contents.
receipt.id_changed: The receipt was changed after it was created: its hash does not match its contents.
receipt.answer_ok: The answer text matches its fingerprint.
receipt.answer_changed: The answer text does not match its fingerprint.
receipt.check_file_missing: {label}: none of the chosen files has the recorded fingerprint.
receipt.check_passage_match: {label}: exact passage found in {file} at the recorded position.
receipt.check_passage_moved: {label}: the passage is in {file}, but not at the recorded position.
receipt.check_passage_mismatch: {label}: the text at the recorded position differs from the excerpt.
receipt.check_text_mismatch: {label}: the text extracted from the file differs from the recorded text.
receipt.check_text_version_differs: {label}: the file was read with a different extraction version; the extracted text differs.
receipt.check_chunk_mismatch: {label}: chunking the file today gives different chunk bounds.
receipt.check_chunk_version_differs: {label}: the chunking rules changed since the receipt was created.
receipt.grounding_same: Source check recomputed for {n} statements: same verdicts as recorded.
receipt.grounding_differs: Source check recomputed for {n} statements: {diff} verdict(s) differ from the receipt.
receipt.grounding_conversation: Some verdicts used earlier chat turns, which receipts do not contain.

workspace.title: On-device workspace
workspace.description: Files are parsed, split into chunks and indexed with BM25 in a background worker on this device, and removed when you reload the page. Nothing is uploaded or synced; only when the cloud assistant or your own server writes an answer are the matching excerpts sent along with the question. Answers cite them as [Doc: file, Chunk: n].
